content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: The notice describes ILBS as an autonomous super-specialty Institute of excellence under GNCT of Delhi and a Deemed-to-be-University by the UGC. Its stated vision is to be a global leader as a beacon of patient care, teaching and research in the field of liver, gall bladder and pancreatobiliary diseases. The Institute is at D – 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi – 110070.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or experience for Instructor (Research). It asks candidates to check the Recruitment Rules and category uploaded on the ILBS website, on the Recruitment Rules page under Career Opportunities, before applying or appearing for interview. Age: the age limit printed for the post is 45 years. The notice does not print a date for counting age. Age relaxation: the upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and by 3 years for OBC candidates. Persons with disabilities: upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years (10 years for SC/ST and 8 years for OBC). OBC: for a post reserved for the OBC category, only applications from candidates with an OBC certificate issued by GNCT of Delhi will be considered. Disability: candidates can apply as per the definition in the Persons with Disabilities (equal opportunities, protection of rights and full participation) Act, 1995. Only persons with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the benefit of PWD reservation. Computer skill: working knowledge of Computer is essential for all the posts. Candidates should check the Recruitment Rules on the official ILBS website for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is printed as PB – III, GP - 6600 (pre-revised), 7th CPC applicable. The pay package is based on the 7th CPC at the pay level applicable for the Institute. The appointment will be on "Contract Basis" for a period of one year. Either side can end the contract by giving the other party not less than three months notice in writing or salary in lieu of the notice period. The date of joining and other conditions will be as per the HR policy of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ILBS Instructor (Research)
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the ILBS website at https://www.ilbs.in/images/media/nonfaculty-form.pdf . Fill in the form and pay the fee by electronic transfer as described in the form. The notice prints the account as Account No. 50100143852078, RTGS/NEFT IFSC - HDFC0000273, HDFC Bank, Site No. 2, OCF Pocket, Sector - C, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi - 110070. Email the duly filled form to [email protected] latest by 20 November 2026. Attach photocopies of degree/certificate/diploma/testimonials/experience certificates. Also submit a copy of a recent passport size photo, the entry relating to date of birth from the matriculation certificate or SSLC, and copies of the degree certificate or diploma duly attested. The notice names the Institute address as Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences, D – 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi – 110070. For queries, candidates may call the HR department on 011-46300000, Ex: 23234 & 23233. For Recruitment Rules and other details, the notice points to http://www.ilbs.in .

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable. Once deposited or submitted it cannot be refunded.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The vacancy is subject to change at any time, and the Institute reserves the right whether or not to fill up any post. No appeal will be entertained or accepted. The vacancy may be removed from the website once the post is filled. A post that falls vacant can also be added at the discretion of ILBS. The Institute also reserves the right of rejecting any or all applications without assigning any reasons. No correspondence will be entertained from candidates about the conduct of interview or reasons for not being called for interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. In case of any dispute, the jurisdiction of court will be Delhi/New Delhi only.
